items.label: Plant Stakes With Rings
items.value: The uniquely designed support ring of the flower stakes can well secure the stems of the plant. The plant support stake will not affect the growth of plant stems. With this plant stake plants will not be injured by binding.

items.label: Sturdy Plant Support Sticks
items.value: Strong metal garden stakes for plants well. Let plants grow straightdly & healthily. Plant supports will prevent plants from entangling, falling over or breaking due to wind, rain or the weight of their flowers and fruits.

items.label: Durable & Reusable Plant Sticks
items.value: Stakes for gardening with green anti rust coating can well blend into plants without affecting the viewing.The metal Garden plant stakes won't rot or attract insects, and can be reused year after year.

items.label: Easy-to-use Plant Stakes
items.value: Garden stake can be installed with just three simple steps. put the plant stem into the support ring along the open slot and adjust it to the suitable position. Then insert the garden sticks into the soil to provide sturdy support for your plants.

items.label: 12 Pack 16Inch Plant Sticks
items.value: This set includes 12P 16 inch metal support stakes and 24P twist ties. Great plant stakes for indoor plants & outdoor plants like peonies, amaryllis, marigolds, coreopsis, tomato seedlings, saplings, vegetables etc.

items.label: Recommended Uses for Product
items.value: supporting various indoor and outdoor plants such as peonies, amaryllis, marigolds, coreopsis, tomato seedlings, saplings, and vegetables

items.label: Special Features
items.value: Reusable, Support Ring Design, Rust-Resistant Metal
